title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: Defense asks court to cancel Friday’s trial
Lead defense counsel Sheila Sison asks the Senate impeachment court to cancel the scheduled trial on Friday, November 13, after they dropped their remaining witnesses for the week.
The defense earlier said it will no longer present BPI senior vice president Paul Roderick Ysmael, and Quezon City Prosecutor Vimar Barcellano.

House prosecutor Terry Ridon takes a jab at the expenses made by Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, Mans Carpio, and asks, “How to be you?”

blocks.text: Prosecutor Robles: Public servants, families should set an example

Private prosecutor Reynaldo Robles says public servants and their families should set an example and avoid “ostentatious” public display of wealth, after the 43rd day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial.

blocks.text: Rappler Recap: Defense seeks to clarify Mans Carpio’s credit card purchases
The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte tries to put a dent on the allegations of exorbitant credit card purchases by Duterte’s husband, Mans Carpio.
Two defense witnesses explain the circumstances behind the transactions that each amounted to more than P200,000.
Sundy Locus recaps the impeachment trial on Thursday, November 12.

blocks.text: Rappler Recap: Prosecution shows ties of defense witness to Mans Carpio
Apart from reiterating the allegedly extravagant lifestyle of Vice President Sara Duterte and husband Mans Carpio, the prosecution showed the supposed ties of Anel Antero, defense witness, to Carpio.
This is to cast doubt on his credibility as a trial witness.
Jairo Bolledo recaps the prosecution’s cross examination on Thursday, November 12, with prosecutor Terry Ridon.
